mapper.sql: id, session_id AS sessionId, lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson_title AS lessonTitle, chapter_id AS chapterId, step_index AS stepIndex, slide_id AS slideId, title, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classroom_bookmarks (user_id, session_id, lesson_id, lesson_title, chapter_id, step_index, slide_id, title) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{lessonId}, #{lessonTitle}, #{chapterId}, #{stepIndex}, #{slideId}, #{title})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM classroom_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM study_rooms r WHERE r.id = classroom_bookmarks.session_id AND r.user_id = classroom_bookmarks.user_id AND r.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM classroom_bookmarks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
